caption: The image depicts a drawing of a square metal lock plate with a protruding rectangular latch extending to the left. The plate is depicted in shades of brown and green, with intricate relief carvings on its surface. The relief shows a pastoral scene featuring several trees with detailed foliage, three human figures, and two animals resembling cows or oxen. One human figure stands to the left, facing forward, while two others are positioned near the center and lower right, engaged with the animals. In the background, there is a circular medallion featuring a geometric design with a diamond shape inside, and rays emanate from a structure that could be interpreted as a barn or house. The lock plate includes a keyhole at the bottom right, and three additional circular holes are distributed at the top left, right, and bottom left corners. The lock plate sits against a plain beige or off-white background, with three irregular yellowish stains at the top, right, and bottom areas. The artist’s signature, "ALF BRUSETH," is found near the lower right area of the image.
title: Door Lock
